systems: GitHub Actions reads each line appended to the $GITHUB_PATH file after a step and prepends it to PATH for every LATER step of the job, never the current one
cargo install writes binaries to $CARGO_HOME/bin; build-binaries sets a per-job CARGO_HOME (infra#430) whose bin dir is on no default PATH
cross is only installed on a runner that lacks it, so the defect hides on any runner that already has cross on PATH and shows on a fresh one (yoga-build)
crux.verdict: Release-pipeline fix only; no forjar runtime behaviour changes from rc.1. The aarch64 linux legs can now build on a runner without cross.
